results.title: Sovico and Hamburg Forge Partnership to Expand Vietnam-Germany Economic Ties
results.description: Sovico Group and the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg, sign a Partnership Agreement on October 13 to expand cooperation in aviation, railways, finance, logistics, technology and education. HO CHI MINH CITY, VIETNAM - Media OutReach Newswire - 20 October 2026 - Sovico Group, one of Vietnam's leading private conglomerates, and the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg signed a Partnership Agreement at Saigon Marina IFC to expand cooperation in aviation, railways, finance, logistics, technology and education. The agreement aims to connect Vietnamese businesses with Hamburg's industrial and commercial ecosystem and its role as a gateway to European markets. Earlier that day, Hamburg First Mayor and President of the Senate Peter Tschentscher met Sovico Chairwoman Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao at HDBank's headquarters to discuss cooperation opportunities between businesses in the Sovico ecosystem and German partners. At the Hamburg? Sovico Strategic Business & Partnership Forum 2026 on October 13, Thao proposed exploring direct air links between Vietnam and Germany and advancing discussions on airport infrastructure, logistics, urban rail, maritime transport and supporting industries. Hamburg highlighted its strengths in aviation, maritime transport, railways, technology research, public transport and sustainable urban development. Potential areas for further discussion include the Long Thanh and Gia Binh airport projects, high-speed rail, urban rail development in Ho Chi Minh City, Dong Nai and Hanoi, smart cities, green industries and technology. The agreement provides a framework for exploring opportunities; participation in individual projects will require further study and subsequent agreements. Sovico and its partners have maintained ties with Germany for more than three decades, particularly in aviation and finance. Hamburg has hosted the handover of more than 100 Airbus aircraft to Vietjet, alongside aircraft-financing services. In finance, DEG, a member of Germany's KfW Group, has invested in HDBank over the past five years. HDBank's German Desk also helps connect Vietnamese and German businesses and support bilateral trade and investment. Thao said Sovico was entering a new investment phase, emphasizing the need for long-term vision, practical investment plans and effective coordination. "I hope the ideas exchanged here today will be translated into cooperation programmes, feasible projects and measurable outcomes," she said. Hamburg State Secretary Liv Assmann said the visit aimed to deepen existing ties and explore new areas of cooperation. Agreements between universities in Hamburg and Vietnam are also expected to create opportunities for training, professional exchange and workforce development. results.title: 5 MLAs’ nomination to J&K LA case listed for Oct 30
results.description: Jammu, Oct 20: High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh will hear the arguments on petitioners’ side on October 30 in the Public Interest Litigation (PIL), challenging the provisions of the J&K Reorganisation Act 2019, authorising the Lieutenant Governor to nominate five MLAs to the J&K Legislative Assembly, over and above its (assembly’s) sanctioned strength. In the meanwhile, the speculations flew thick and fast that the government was likely to take a final call vis-à-vis nomination of MLAs very soon. Though there was no official word on this account yet, main petitioner JKPCC chief spokesperson Ravinder Sharma stated, “As long as the matter is sub-judice, the government can not go ahead with the nominations. We had raised this issue before the court earlier also.” Main argument of Sharma, who has challenged the relevant provisions of the J&K Reorganisation Act, providing for nomination of five MLAs by the Lieutenant Governor, over and above the sanctioned strength of the Legislative Assembly of J&K, with full voting rights, is that the provision, having the potential of converting a minority government into majority government, is against the basic structure of the constitution.

results.title: PlayZap pledges its YouTube Playables income to buying back and burning PZP once ad revenue sharing starts
results.description: In Brief:PlayZap (official site) Games reported that its YouTube Playables titles have topped 500,000 plays and 20,000 hours of gameplay. Once YouTube enables ad revenue sharing, the studio says all of its Playables revenue will be used to buy and burn $PZP.YouTube hasn't enabled that for PlayZap yet, so no money is funding the buyback at this point. In a post on X, PlayZap Games said it will send all of its YouTube Playables earnings into buying back and burning $PZP. Timing is the catch: nothing happens until YouTube enables ad revenue sharing. The studio paired the pledge with fresh usage figures, saying its Playables games have crossed 500,000 plays and 20,000 hours of gameplay. PlayZap’s games on YouTube Playables have passed 500K plays and 20,000 hours of gameplay. Once YouTube turns on ad revenue sharing, all of PlayZap’s revenue from Playables will go to buying and burning $PZP. #GameFi #BuildPlayZap GamesView on X ↗ The studio wrote: "Once YouTube turns on ad revenue sharing, all of PlayZap's revenue from Playables will go to buying and burning $PZP."Waiting on YouTubePlayZap gave no timeline for when it thinks revenue sharing will begin. It also didn't offer a revenue estimate or say how often buybacks would happen. Playables revenue sharing isn't broadly available from YouTube yet. The company's developer documentation calls it a pilot involving a select number of creators and lists no rate. For now, the 500,000 plays give the studio exposure, but they produce no Playables income that could flow to the token. Two games live, five more comingAccording to PlayZap, those 500,000-plus plays came from only two games live on the platform. Across its whole catalog, the studio has reported more than 3 million app downloads and 25 million total gameplays, plus 60% growth in YouTube subscribers. PlayZap listed five titles on Oct. 12 that it expects to bring to Playables in the coming weeks: Rush Party, Jungle Fury, Scrub Tycoon, Bus IO and AstroLock. The studio called Rush Party the second of the five, and the Rush Party trailer was scheduled for Oct. 16. None of the five has an individual launch date yet. From app stores to PlayablesIn July, PlayZap submitted its first game to YouTube for review. Titles need Google's approval before they show up in the Playables catalog. Until then, the studio's games were available only through its own app on Google Play and the App Store, along with a desktop version. The platform is built on Polygon and pays tournament rewards in PZP across casual games like solitaire and 8 ball pool. Burn historyA buyback paid for by Playables would come on top of burns PlayZap already carries out. Its 2026 roadmap includes a token burn at the end of every quarter, with the Q1 and Q2 burns marked done. The same roadmap shows a burn of 20% of team tokens completed in the first half of 2025. PlayZap has said it's reworking PZP around a deflation model that combines quarterly burns with staking. According to the whitepaper, PZP has a maximum supply of 150 million tokens, and about 5.1 million have been burned. The burns started earlier still. In May 2023, the team announced plans to burn 1,000,000 PZP to keep circulating supply in check. Back then, the idea was to burn 5% of the total PZP invested in the gaming platform each month, up to 50,000 tokens a month. PlayZap closed its post with the hashtags #GameFi and #Build.
